display.title: Tehillim for the Rebbe's Recovery: The Power of Children's Prayers
display.summary_short: A few days before Purim 5752, Uncle Yossi explains the power of children's prayers and leads listeners in Tehillim chapter 20 for the Rebbe's complete recovery.
display.summary_long: A clip from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, a few days before Purim 5752, after the Rebbe fell ill. Uncle Yossi explains that children played a central role in the Purim miracle: their pure voices in Torah and prayer, the 'voice of Yaakov', are the strongest power on earth, able to reach the heavens and turn a bad decree into a blessing. When Haman plotted against the Jews, Mordechai gathered 22,000 children and learned Torah with them, and their voices brought the redemption. Today, too, Hashem listens to children. Uncle Yossi asks everyone to join a special request for the Rebbe's complete recovery so that he can continue spreading Yiddishkeit, and he leads chapter 20 of Tehillim word by word for listeners to repeat, opening and closing with a prayer for the Rebbe's refuah shleimah. The clip ends as he introduces the Shema.
display.lesson: Children's prayers and Torah learning are a powerful force; Hashem listens to every child who asks.

date.note: Cut from episode 520, which ends 'be in shul tomorrow night to listen to the Megillah' (Purim 5752 began 18 March 1992). The same segment re-aired in episode 523 (Nissan).
